thread:
Elaine: quick sync — proposing a set of automatic rollout gates for canaries/A-Bs in the console. TL;DR: auto-pause when p95 latency or error rate breaches, and an emergency stop for token-cost spikes. Want feedback before I wire into the UX.

Sam: this sounds necessary. two quick Qs: 1) baseline for token-cost — per-model or per-route? 2) window sizing for the SLO checks?

Raj: per-route baseline makes more sense IMO. workloads differ a lot. we should also have a min-sample guard so tiny traffic doesn't trigger pause. e.g., require >= 200 requests in the window. @Elaine :eyes:

Elaine: agree on per-route and min-sample. thinking config defaults: p95 latency threshold 1200ms, error_rate > 0.5% (5m window), min_requests=200, and cost_spike factor=2.

Marta: +1. Also add an operator-visible reason for pause so SREs can triage quickly (e.g., "pause: p95 1500ms > 1200ms"). can we also auto-notify channels? :bell:

Sam: we should let teams choose actions: `pause`, `rollback`, `throttle(percentage)`. console should offer quick buttons for each after a gate trips.

Elaine: yes — plan: action enum = [pause, rollback, throttle, notify-only]. Default = pause. We should also have an auto-unpause policy (manual by default, but optional auto-resume if metrics return to baseline for X windows).

Raj: note on measurement: for latency we should use synthetic-inferred traces + production p95 to avoid skew from e2e spikes. and for multi-model routes compute weighted p95 by tokens.

Marta: UI copy suggestion: "Pause rollout when recent performance indicates user impact." keep it short.

Sam: here's a prototype of the rollout guard JSON that the API would accept — we can display this in the console and let users tweak values: 

```
{
  "guard_name": "default-performance-gates",
  "rules": [
    {"metric":"p95_latency_ms","threshold":1200,"window_mins":5,"min_requests":200,"action":"pause"},
    {"metric":"error_rate_pct","threshold":0.5,"window_mins":5,"min_requests":200,"action":"pause"},
    {"metric":"token_cost_ratio","threshold":2.0,"window_mins":10,"min_requests":100,"action":"pause"}
  ],
  "auto_resume": {"enabled":false,"stable_windows":2},
  "on_trip": {"notify_channels":["#prod-rollouts"],"reason_template":"{{rule}} breached: {{value}}"}
}
```

Raj: couple of additions: 1) make `token_cost_ratio` source-labeled (e.g., compare against baseline model-version), 2) allow composition with `AND/OR` logic between rules for complex policies.

Elaine: good catches. initial MVP uses OR semantics (any rule trips => action). we'll add composition later. also, deploy-bot integration — it should post when a gate trips and include links to the rollout + metrics snapshot.

deploy-bot: [automated] canary/rollout 2024-06-30T10:10:00Z started for route `completions-prod` (version v2).

Marta: ops question — should paused canaries keep consuming capacity? i.e., do we keep instances warm or scale down to save $$. 

Sam: prefer scale-down by default, with a keep-warm toggle. if paused for more than X minutes we can shrink to 0 and preserve state for quick resume.

Elaine: next steps: I'll draft a minimal API contract + console mockups with the OR semantics, defaults above, and a manual auto-resume toggle. @Raj @Sam please drop any hard constraints you need for infra by EOD Friday.

Raj: will do. also please include a flag so Dedicated customers can override default thresholds via org policy.

Marta: thumbs up. can we add a lightweight audit event for every gate decision? important for compliance.

Elaine: yep — audit event + human who acknowledged/unpaused. thanks all. I'll post the PR link once it's up. :rocket:
